title.zh: Telegram贴纸功能曝零点击漏洞，iOS可无交互代码执行
title.en: Telegram贴纸功能曝零点击漏洞，iOS可无交互代码执行

current_state.zh: Researchers at a Tokyo security conference disclosed a zero-click vulnerability in Telegram's sticker feature that lets an attacker execute code on iOS devices without any user interaction, a risk assessment Telegram disputes.
current_state.en: Researchers at a Tokyo security conference disclosed a zero-click vulnerability in Telegram's sticker feature that lets an attacker execute code on iOS devices without any user interaction, a risk assessment Telegram disputes.
